key.name: poll-interval
key.description: Seconds between tunnel status checks. Minimum is 1. Traygolin checks every second while connecting.

key.name: tray-icon
key.description: Show Traygolin in the system tray.

key.name: start-at-login
key.description: Install an XDG autostart entry so Traygolin opens when you log in.

key.name: connect-at-start
key.description: Connect when Traygolin starts, if you are already logged in.

key.name: mtu
key.description: Maximum transmission unit for the Pangolin tunnel interface, passed to pangolin up.

key.name: holepunch
key.description: Allow NAT holepunching when bringing the tunnel up.

key.name: disable-relay
key.description: Do not fall back to relaying if a direct path cannot be established.
